pkgmetadata.longdescription: rocBLAS, hipBLAS, hipBLASLt, rocFFT, hipFFT, rocRAND, hipRAND, rocSPARSE, hipSPARSE, rocSOLVER, hipSOLVER and Composable Kernel, taken from AMD's prebuilt TheRock gfx1151 distribution rather than built from source. The Tensile and rocFFT kernel databases in that tarball are the tuning data a source build would have to regenerate, and does not produce for gfx1151.
